# Environment variables

<!-- GENERATED by tools/dart-doc-gen from EnvVarDoc. Do not edit. -->

Optional environment overrides BXP reads at startup — all of them optional, BXP works with none set.

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_CLI_PATH</code> | Absolute path to the `bxp-cli` binary the desktop app should run, instead of the one bundled beside it. |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_EXAMPLES_PATH</code> | Absolute path to the `bxp-cli.examples.json` the desktop app offers templates from. |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_DIAGNOSTIC</code> | Set to `1` to write a diagnostic trace (plus captured engine stderr) next to the preferences file — attach it when reporting a bug. |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_GUI_MCP_HOST</code> | Bind host of the desktop app's agent-control server (default `127.0.0.1`). The saved preference wins over this. |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_GUI_MCP_PORT</code> | Bind port of the desktop app's agent-control server (default `7717`). The saved preference wins over this. |
| <code class="hl-key">BXP_GUI_MCP_AUTO_APPROVE</code> | Seeds the auto-approve gate at startup, so an agent can drive a freshly launched app without a click. The persisted toggle is the one that survives across launches. |
